items.name: Urban Rest Stop – Downtown
items.summary: A free hygiene center where people without housing can use restrooms, take a shower and do a load of laundry, with soap and basic toiletries supplied. You sign up for a shower in person on the same day. Laundry can be booked by phone or in person.

cost.notes: LIHI: all services are provided at no cost.

hours.note: Per LIHI locations page: showers and laundry 6:30am–2:30pm, restrooms close 3:30pm. Shower sign-up is same-day and in person only. The site's own page shows an undated 'until further notice' schedule instead: Mon–Fri 7:30–4:30, closed 12–1.

items.notes: The address disagrees between sources: LIHI's page gives 1925 9th Ave and urbanreststop.org gives 1924 Ninth Avenue (98101). I used 1924. The hours also disagree three ways. LIHI's page says Mon–Fri 6:30am–4pm with no weekends. urbanreststop.org shows an undated 'UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE' notice: Mon–Fri 7:30–4:30, closed 12–1, laundry 7:30–10:30 and 1–1:45, showers 7:30–10:30 and 1–2. Below that notice it still lists an older regular schedule that includes weekends. I recorded LIHI's hours; call to confirm. Rules from LIHI: one laundry load every other day and one shower per day. No laundry pods, shoes, comforters or large sleeping bags. Coveralls are provided while your clothes wash. Eligibility is described only as for unsheltered individuals and families, and ID is not mentioned. Accessibility is not stated.

items.name: Urban Rest Stop – Ballard
items.summary: A free neighborhood hygiene center in Ballard offering restrooms, showers and self-service laundry. Shower and laundry slots are same-day only, and showers are booked in person.

cost.notes: LIHI: all services are provided at no cost.

hours.note: Showers 6:30–9am. Laundry runs 6:30am–12pm, with the last appointment at 12pm.
Closed 10–11:30am. Showers 11:30am–12:30pm, with no shower sign-ups after 12:30. Restrooms close at 1:30pm.

items.notes: The entrance is behind the gray gate to the left of the Cheryl Chow Court entrance. Laundry can be booked by phone or in person; showers are booked in person only, and all bookings are same-day. No weekend hours are listed. The ZIP (98107) does not appear on the pages I fetched; I added it from the street address, so verify it. Eligibility, ID and accessibility are not stated.

items.name: Compass Hygiene Center
items.summary: A drop-in basement hygiene center in the Compass Center building for people experiencing homelessness. You can use the restroom, take a hot shower and wash a load of laundry there.
items.address: 210 Alaskan Way S (basement level), Seattle, WA 98104

cost.notes: Cost is not stated on the official pages; it is presumed free but unconfirmed.

hours.note: Hours conflict: the hygiene-center page says 7am–4pm. Closed holidays.

items.notes: Compass's own pages disagree on the weekday opening time. The Get Help and CMSC pages say 8:30am–4pm; the Hygiene Center page says 7am–4pm. All three agree on Saturday 8am–12pm. I used 8:30. The building is at the corner of S Washington St and Alaskan Way (look for the orange archway); the mail address is 77 S Washington St. Cost, laundry limits and accessibility are not stated on official pages; directories mention limits, but those were not used. The page states 'Drop-in basis during regular business hours.'

items.name: Elizabeth Gregory Home Day Shelter
items.summary: A women's day center where women can use accessible showers, restrooms and laundry, and pick up personal care items and emergency clothing. It is daytime only, with no overnight beds.

cost.notes: Cost is not mentioned on the page; it is presumed free but unconfirmed.

items.notes: Women only. The official page names no minimum age; directories say 18+, but that was not used. The page mentions 'accessible showers'. It does not say whether shower or laundry appointments are needed. A brochure mentions an early close on the first Tuesday of the month, but that is not on the official page.

items.name: Dave's Day Center (Hygiene Center)
items.summary: A weekday hygiene day center for adults experiencing homelessness. Guests can shower, wash clothes and get toiletries, and staff help with applications and shelter referrals.

cost.notes: Cost is not stated; it is presumed free but unconfirmed.

items.notes: The page says the center serves 'adults experiencing homelessness' and welcomes anyone who walks in. Toiletries include razors, shampoo, deodorant, toothbrushes and soap. Lunch is provided by meal partners. Guests sign in at the front desk. Immanuel Community Services is affiliated with a church, but the pages do not mention any religious participation, so it is recorded as unknown. Restroom access is not explicitly listed on the program page. Accessibility is not stated.

items.name: Free Showers – Delridge Community Center
items.summary: The City runs free drop-in showers at this West Seattle community center for anyone in need, including Seattle Public Schools students. Showers are closed on the first Friday of each month for deep cleaning.

hours.note: Last shower 3:45pm (Parkways lists 10am–4pm). Closed the first Friday of each month; listed 2026 closure: Dec. 11.

src: Seattle Parks and Recreation's free shower program – Parkways
items.notes: The Parkways post (updated Jan 2, 2026) lists Delridge as one of the five program sites and asks people to call to verify hours. The Delridge page itself shows drop-in showers Mon–Fri 10am–3:45pm. Note that Dec. 11, 2026 is a Friday but not the first Friday of the month, so the closure-date list and the 'first Friday' rule conflict. Rules on towels and time limits are not stated. Religious is set to 'none' because this is a city program.

items.name: Free Showers – Meadowbrook Community Center
items.summary: The City offers free weekday showers at this northeast Seattle community center for students and residents in need.
src: Seattle Parks and Recreation's free shower program – Parkways
items.notes: The center page and the Parkways post agree on Mon–Fri 10:30am–4:30pm. No rules (towels, time limits) are stated. Restroom access is implied by the page's 'shower and restroom facilities' wording.

items.name: Free Showers – Green Lake Community Center
items.summary: The City offers free showers twice a week at the Green Lake community center for students and residents in need.
items.address: 7201 East Green Lake Dr N, Seattle, WA 98115

hours.note: Last shower 12:30pm. These are Fall 2026 hours, which began Sept 8.

src: Seattle Parks and Recreation's free shower program – Parkways
items.notes: Hours are seasonal (Fall 2026), so recheck when the winter schedule starts. Towels and time limits are not stated.

items.name: University District Youth Center
items.summary: A drop-in center for young people ages 12–24 where they can shower, do laundry and get clothing during weekday hours.

cost.notes: Cost is not stated; it is presumed free but unconfirmed.

items.notes: Youth only (ages 12–24). The same YouthCare page also lists the Orion Center drop-in (1828 Yale Ave, 98101). I left Orion out because its hours read 'Monday-Fri 3:00pm-6:00pm' plus 'Monday - Sunday 10am-6pm until the end of March', and it is unclear which schedule applies in November 2026. Accessibility is not stated.

items.name: Chief Seattle Club Day Center
items.summary: A day center for urban Native people experiencing homelessness, offering showers, laundry and personal hygiene services to its members. Membership goes through the front desk and a case manager.

cost.notes: Cost is not stated; it is presumed free but unconfirmed.

hours.note: Front desk hours, listed as '7AM - 2PM Daily'. Showers 7am–1pm. Laundry 7–11am, pickup at 1pm.

items.notes: Services are for members. The page defines members as individuals struggling with homelessness who identify with the Club's mission of serving urban Native people, and membership requires case manager approval. It does not say whether Native or Indigenous identity is strictly required. I did not set referral=true, but the membership step may function like an intake. The page does not say whether the 'daily' hours include weekends for showers. No age limit is stated.
